Limitation: English Wikipedia comments do not represent every online platform.
Recommended Future Action: Validate on platform-specific data before deployment.

Limitation: Subjective toxicity labels and conflicting annotations introduce noise.
Recommended Future Action: Retain disagreement and use contextual human review.

Limitation: Rare categories have limited positive examples.
Recommended Future Action: Report per-label AP, F1 and support alongside aggregate metrics.

Limitation: Completed configurations use a single fixed training seed.
Recommended Future Action: Repeat training with additional seeds in future research.

Limitation: Full-data training also changes the optimizer-update budget.
Recommended Future Action: Do not attribute all improvements solely to training-data size.

Limitation: Validation performance exceeds official test performance.
Recommended Future Action: Report both partitions and investigate distribution differences.

Limitation: The transformer input window is limited to 256 tokens.
Recommended Future Action: Review long comments and investigate longer-context models.
Use human review for identity-related and ambiguous predictions.

Limitation: Lexical mentions do not establish actual demographic membership.
Recommended Future Action: Avoid claims of demographic parity or absence of discrimination.

Limitation: Fixed templates have limited linguistic diversity.
Recommended Future Action: Obtain independent human annotations and broader templates.

Limitation: LIME provides local approximations rather than causal explanations.
Recommended Future Action: Report fidelity, deletion and retention evidence together.

Limitation: Qualitative error and explanation interpretations are AI-assisted.
Recommended Future Action: Complete independent review before claiming human validation.

Limitation: Sigmoid scores have not been established as calibrated probabilities.
Recommended Future Action: Evaluate calibration using separate development evidence.

Limitation: Offline GPU throughput is not single-request service latency.
Recommended Future Action: Benchmark end-to-end latency and memory in the target environment.

Limitation: Reducing moderation workload may increase missed positive comments.
Recommended Future Action: Preserve frozen thresholds and disclose both error costs.

Limitation: The official benchmark was historically familiar to the team.
Recommended Future Action: Treat it as held out for this pipeline, not an unfamiliar dataset.

Limitation: Bootstrap intervals do not capture training-seed variability.
Recommended Future Action: Treat intervals as conditional and unadjusted for multiplicity.

Limitation: Some optional experiments were skipped due to compute constraints.
Recommended Future Action: Document skipped runs and never report them as completed.
